'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Barry Alperstein LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Barry Alperstein]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Oh, Here's a fun fact. You made out w/ your sister man
* '''Username:''' MrFromMars
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
